attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing – Dentist and Dental Hygienist Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Lecture, conference, seminar or training sessions (blocks of at least 50 min) approved/sponsored by government agencies, accredited institutions, professional associations, ADA, ADHA, UDA/UDHA, recognized health care associations or peer study clubs; max 15 h online/home study with exam; max 10 h teaching; max 3 h practice/office management; up to 15% as volunteer direct patient care
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours prorated by the date of first licensure within the two-year cycle.
rules.alternatives: Division may defer or waive CPE under R156-1-308d.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation two years after the end of the renewal cycle.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-69-303, R156-69-304a; Utah Code 58-37-6.5

topics.who: Holders of a Utah controlled substance license: controlled substance prescribing CE (Utah Code 58-37-6.5)
Current CPR/BLS (or ACLS/PALS per permit); recertification hours do not count

rules.notes: Dental licenses renew May 31 of even years. Current CPR/BLS (or ACLS/PALS per permit) required; recertification hours do not count. Sedation permits: minimal 2 h, moderate 4 h + 10 cases, deep/GA 8 h + 30 cases. Dermal fillers / botulinum toxin: 1 h each if administered.
